features.name: duration_zscore
features.description: Standardized duration using training mean and std for scale-normalized distance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes feature scale so duration contributes proportionally to KNN distance.

features.name: credit_amount_log_zscore
features.description: Log-transformed credit amount standardized to reduce skew and normalize scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed credit amounts for stable Euclidean distance.

features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Standardized age for balanced contribution in neighborhood geometry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents age scale from dominating or being dominated by other numerics.

features.name: installment_burden_ratio
features.description: Monthly installment burden proxy: installment commitment times credit amount divided by duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a meaningful similarity dimension separating borrowers by repayment pressure.

features.name: credit_per_month
features.description: Average credit amount per month of loan duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures loan intensity as a single distance dimension.

features.name: age_to_duration_ratio
features.description: Ratio of borrower age to loan duration in months scaled.
features.expected_model_benefit: Distinguishes young short-loan borrowers from older long-loan ones for neighborhood structure.

features.name: dist_to_typical_borrower
features.description: Euclidean-like distance from an unsupervised central prototype defined by training means of key numerics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a global outlierness signal that helps KNN weight atypical rows.

features.name: dist_to_young_smallloan_prototype
features.description: Distance from an unsupervised prototype representing young borrowers with small short loans (age=25, duration=12, log credit_amount=7.0).
features.expected_model_benefit: Anchors a cluster centroid for one common borrower archetype to improve neighborhood geometry.

features.name: dist_to_mature_largeloan_prototype
features.description: Distance from an unsupervised prototype representing older borrowers with large long-duration loans (age=50, duration=36, log credit_amount=8.6).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a second archetype anchor enabling KNN to localize different borrower regions.

features.name: stability_score
features.description: Semantic stability indicator combining housing ownership, employment tenure, residence duration, and job skill into a 0-1 score; higher means more stable life situation. Computed from row values only via ordinal mapping (own housing=1 else 0, employment >=7 years=1 / 4<=X<7=0.75 / 1<=X<4=0.5 / <1=0.25 / unemployed=0, residence_since/4, job skilled or high qualif=1 else 0.5) averaged.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a meaningful low-dimensional similarity axis for KNN to group stable vs unstable applicants.

features.name: financial_buffer_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of financial cushion derived from savings_status, checking_status, and property_magnitude mapped to 0-1 (e.g., savings >=1000=1.0, 500<=X<1000=0.75, 100<=X<500=0.5, <100=0.25, no known savings=0.1; checking >=200=1.0, 0<=X<200=0.6, <0=0.1, no checking=0.4; property real estate=1.0, life insurance=0.7, car=0.5, no known property=0.0) averaged.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses multiple categorical wealth signals into one distance-friendly continuous dimension.

features.name: loan_risk_profile_score
features.description: Semantic ordinal score from credit_history and purpose riskiness mapped to 0-1 (credit_history: critical/other existing=0.2, delayed previously=0.4, existing paid=0.7, all paid=0.9, no credits/all paid=0.5; purpose: used car/radio-tv/furniture=0.7, new car/business=0.5, education/repairs=0.3, retraining/other/domestic=0.4) averaged.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an interpretable low-dimensional axis enabling KNN to align with credit-quality neighborhoods.
